title: FlyMAD: rapid thermogenetic control of neuronal activity in freely walking Drosophila.
source_locator: Supplementary Video 'Activating Moonwalker neurons with TrpA1' legend (publisher page); Fig. 2c not accessible
quote: Thermogenetic activation of moonwalker neurons induces backwards walking.
mapping_basis: 'Moonwalker neurons' is the full form of MDN (kit driver_lines.csv row 'Moonwalker DN (MDN)'); synonyms.csv maps MDN to DNp50; VT50660 is also a hemidriver of kit line MDN-1 (DNp50). 'Moonwalker' itself is not a listed synonym, hence medium.
stimulation: FlyMAD infrared laser targeted to freely walking fly (thermogenetic heating); laser power and duration not readable in the accessible text (pass-1 listed 208 mW, ~2 s from Fig. 2c, unverified here)
notes: Full text paywalled (Nature page: 'This is a preview of subscription content'); labelled from the supplementary video legend shown on the publisher page (genotype 'VT50660-Gal4; UAS-TrpA1'). Fig. 2c legend and Methods (laser power, sex, n) could not be read. Expression pattern of the full VT50660-Gal4 line not described in accessible text, so line_specificity = unknown; it is a broad Gal4 line, not the MDN split, so off-target labelling is possible. Backward walking coded per convention as yes for all leg pairs; effect_on_walking left not_assessed because no forward-speed measure was readable.
